newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Engil hits new stock high.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Engil hits new stock high.

text.p: Shares in construction company Engil-SGPS surged to a new high for the year of 1,697 escudos on Thursday, up 37 escudos on Wednesday's close
After touching the high, the stock eased back to 1,681 but traders said it could still break through 1,700 escudos.
They said that Engel was being boosted by optimism the group will get some of the business for the building of the underground system in Oporto.
Traders said that the special jury studying bids for the Oporto metro was expected to announce soon which two consortia would go through to the final round.
"Demand for the stock has eased a bit now but it would not surprise me if it rallied again through 1,700 escudos," said one trader.
